question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"paralel"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**parallel**". (समांतर)
 
• **"parallel"** refers to two or more lines that are the same distance apart at every point and never meet. (समांतर)
 
 
• **Example: **She drew two **parallel **lines on the paper.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Humorous **(हास्यप्रद): Something that is funny or makes people laugh.

 
 
• **Example:** His **humorous **remarks always lighten the mood.
 
 
 
• **Achieve **(प्राप्त करना): To successfully reach a goal or complete something.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to **achieve **her dreams.
 
 
 
• **Familiar **(परिचित): Well-known or easily recognized.
 
 
• **Example:** The song sounds **familiar**, I think I've heard it before.
